title: MonsterBox data/characters.json
description: Top-level character registry. Each entry needs a numeric id and a name. An inline sttConfig is permitted for backward compatibility (Orlok) — if present, it must be an object (full conformance to stt-config.schema.json is not enforced here to avoid coupling the registry schema to per-character file validation).

hardware.description: 'none' marks a node with no hardware of its own (Alpha, the Orchestration Console dev box): parts.json must be empty, and the pact suite checks that instead of requiring an enabled part.
